about: Built by tools/build_nrm.py. The grounds and the building’s outline come from OpenStreetMap. The rooms inside are approximate: the museum’s website could not be read, so they are drawn from descriptions of the building (the octagonal Four Freedoms gallery under the cupola, galleries in a line, more galleries one floor down).
source: OpenStreetMap (grounds and outlines); Robert A. M. Stern Architects’ and visitors’ descriptions of the building; the museum’s exhibition announcements (Oct 2026)
units: grounds: metres x 3; building: metres x 10; turned 17.5 degrees (north is a little to the left of up)
